methodology.observation_window_basis: Window starts at the previous successful canonical run's window_end and ends at the current observation cutoff; the unusually long window reflects missed persisted weekday runs.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing difficult-to-reverse commercialization, deployment, manufacturing, infrastructure, regulatory, and technical milestones.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution sources.
methodology.repeat_policy: Canonical event fingerprints were checked; repeated events are included only for material updates with preserved event_key and material_update_from.

findings.headline: NVIDIA partners target up to 2 GW of Australian AI infrastructure by 2027
findings.summary: NVIDIA said Australian cloud and data-center partners plan up to a 2-gigawatt buildout by 2027 around NVIDIA DSX infrastructure.
findings.why_it_matters: A multi-gigawatt regional commitment is difficult-to-reverse evidence that sovereign and regional AI capacity expansion remains capital intensive and geographically broad.
findings.trend_statement: AI infrastructure continues scaling from individual clusters toward utility-scale regional capacity.

findings.headline: Waymo begins fully autonomous public rides in Las Vegas
findings.summary: Waymo began serving public riders in Las Vegas on September 14 across a nearly 24-mile service area using its sixth-generation Driver and Ojai vehicles.
findings.why_it_matters: Commercial rider service is stronger evidence than mapping or testing and extends fully autonomous ride-hailing into another major U.S. market.
findings.trend_statement: Robotaxi deployment continues moving from pilots toward multi-city commercial operations.

findings.headline: Siemens and P&G scale AI quality inspection across manufacturing operations worldwide
findings.summary: P&G is expanding Siemens-based AI inspection across manufacturing operations worldwide; Siemens reports 10–20% scrap reduction and deployments commissioned five to ten times faster than traditional vision systems.
findings.why_it_matters: Measured operating gains and global rollout show industrial AI crossing from pilots into repeatable production deployment.
findings.trend_statement: Industrial AI is becoming standardized production infrastructure with measurable quality and deployment benefits.

source_links.title: Siemens — P&G global AI quality inspection rollout

findings.headline: FDA approves first gene therapy for Sanfilippo syndrome type A
findings.summary: FDA approved Fayuvi, the first treatment for pediatric MPS IIIA, a rare progressive neurodevelopmental disease previously managed only symptomatically.
findings.why_it_matters: A disease-modifying gene therapy reached regulatory approval in an indication with no prior approved treatment.
findings.trend_statement: Gene therapy continues converting rare-disease programs into approved commercial treatments.

source_links.title: FDA — First gene therapy for pediatric Sanfilippo syndrome type A

findings.headline: NASA activates Roman’s primary instrument and checks out its coronagraph in space
findings.summary: NASA successfully activated Roman’s 300-megapixel Wide Field Instrument and performed initial checks of its Coronagraph Instrument after launch.
findings.why_it_matters: The mission moved beyond launch into verified operation of its core science hardware, materially reducing deployment risk.
findings.trend_statement: Roman is progressing from launch toward operational science capability.
